nodes.text: Surging HMPV cases in northern China have sparked concern, but experts say a Covid-like pandemic is unlikely. Human metapneumovirus causes flu-like symptoms and can lead to serious complications. No vaccine yet, so let's focus on hygiene and caution. Watch our quick video summary https://t.co/87JBp4bo1W
